name: Joram
description: King living at the time of Divided Monarchy

points: Ahaziah dies according to the word of the Lord that Elijah had spoken, and Jehoram reigns in his stead because Ahaziah had no son. The rest of the acts of Ahaziah are written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel.

note.label: 2 Kings 1: Ahaziah Inquires of Beelzebub and Dies

points: Jehoram the son of Ahab begins to reign over Israel in Samaria in the eighteenth year of Jehoshaphat king of Judah and reigns twelve years. He works evil in the sight of the Lord, but not like his father and mother, for he puts away the image of Baal that his father had made.

note.label: 2 Kings 3: Three Kings and the Water in the Ditches

points: Jehoram son of Jehoshaphat begins to reign over Judah and walks in the way of the kings of Israel because the daughter of Ahab was his wife.

note.label: 2 Kings 8: The Prophet Weeps Over Israel's Coming Affliction

points: Ahaziah son of Jehoram begins to reign over Judah and walks in the way of the house of Ahab, being the son-in-law of that house, a picture of the generational curse passed from father to son.

note.label: 2 Kings 8: The Prophet Weeps Over Israel's Coming Affliction

points: He goes with Jehoram son of Ahab to war against Hazael king of Syria, and the Syrians wound Jehoram at Ramah.
Jehoram returns to Jezreel to be healed, and Ahaziah goes down to see him, setting the stage for both kings to meet Jehu's judgment.

note.label: 2 Kings 8: The Prophet Weeps Over Israel's Coming Affliction

points: Jehu conspires against Jehoram and charges that none escape the city to carry the news to Jezreel.

note.label: 2 Kings 9: Jehu Anointed and the Wicked Kings Cut Off

points: He rides toward Jezreel where Jehoram lay wounded, and Ahaziah king of Judah had come down to see him.

note.label: 2 Kings 9: Jehu Anointed and the Wicked Kings Cut Off

points: Joram, the son of Ahab and Jezebel, rode out to meet Jehu and asked, Is it peace, Jehu? And he answered, What peace, so long as the whoredoms of thy mother Jezebel and her witchcrafts are so many? There's no peace as long as you got a wicked woman in power. And that's what America likes to do: set up wicked women and empower women that go against God.

note.label: Are You A Strong Independent Woman?

points: Jehoram himself goes out and asks if it is peace, and Jehu answers that there can be no peace while the whoredoms and witchcrafts of his mother Jezebel are so many.

note.label: 2 Kings 9: Jehu Anointed and the Wicked Kings Cut Off

points: Joram turned his hands and fled, saying, There is treachery, O Ahaziah. And Jehu drew a bow with his full strength and smote Jehoram between his arms, and the arrow went out at his heart.

note.label: Are You A Strong Independent Woman?

points: Jehu draws his bow with full strength and smites Jehoram through the heart, then casts him into the portion of Naboth the Jezreelite according to the word of the Most High.

note.label: 2 Kings 9: Jehu Anointed and the Wicked Kings Cut Off

points: Ahaziah walked after their counsel and went with Jehoram son of Ahab to war against Hazael king of Syria at Ramoth-gilead, where Jehoram was wounded.

note.label: 2 Chronicles 22: Ahaziah and the Rise of Athaliah

points: He went down to see the wounded Jehoram at Jezreel, and the destruction of Ahaziah was of the Most High, for by going he came into the path of Jehu, whom the Most High had anointed to cut off the house of Ahab.

note.label: 2 Chronicles 22: Ahaziah and the Rise of Athaliah
